purpose: Teach: 堅持/不均衡/商会/公訴/報い/困窮/参る/折り合い

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、法治原則、絶対、堅持、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are committed to upholding the rule of law. We appreciate that deeply.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady opening. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. No rush. The tone of someone speaking for an institution, not just himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、不均衡、絶対、是正、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご助言、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the police's guidance in addressing the imbalances we've seen in the community.
lines.style: Attentive, aligned. Slightly deferential without being servile. Clear enunciation. The cadence of someone listening carefully and responding thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 歴史ある、本気で、絶対、商会、絶対、の、絶対、防犯協力、絶対、警察、絶対、感謝しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your organization has a long history, and the police deeply appreciate your commitment to crime prevention.
lines.style: Formal, procedural. Slight pause after 'history' to acknowledge weight. Warm undercurrent beneath the official language. Spoken as though reading from the heart, not from notes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、公訴、絶対、取り下げの、絶対、可能性、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご見解伺います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'd like to understand the police's perspective on whether prosecution might be withdrawn in this case.
lines.style: Careful, hopeful. Softly earnest. The question lands gently but clearly. Slight tension underneath—this matters—but delivered with respect for the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 長年の市民協力の、本気で、絶対、報い、絶対、警察、絶対、感謝、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police recognize the value of years of cooperation from citizens like yourselves. That loyalty matters to us.
lines.style: Warm but official. A slight shift toward acknowledgment of their contribution. Slower pace on 'years of cooperation.' Genuine appreciation breaking through protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。困窮、本気で、絶対、している、絶対、被害者支援、絶対、警察様、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to supporting victims in their time of hardship, as the police are doing.
lines.style: Firm and earnest. Speaking to something that matters. No performative tone—just conviction. Slight emphasis on 'supporting victims' as shared ground.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、市民の元に、絶対、自ら、絶対、参る、絶対、姿勢、絶対、大切にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police believe in going directly to the citizens we serve. That approach is something we value.
lines.style: Composed, reflective. Slight pause before 'citizens we serve'—acknowledging the human element beneath the role. Even-keeled but carrying real meaning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と、本気で、絶対、折り合い、絶対、つけて、絶対、防犯対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working together with the police to move crime prevention efforts forward.
lines.style: Resolved, measured. The close of an agreement. Clear and direct. A slight settling into the tone—the negotiation has landed somewhere good. Professional but with residual warmth.
